title: Super Supportive · Episode 21 · 你会在意
description: A food hunt becomes a conversation Alden has been avoiding. Boe has a terrible plan for making it less serious.

sources.title: Super Supportive — Sleyca, Chapter 8
sources.note: Supplied EPUB, butcher-shop conversation from early February until before wordchain class. No funeral decision is invented; Hannah’s fate remains uncertain. Choices change private reflections, not canonical events.

planning.sourceBoundary: Full pinned butcher-shop conversation, ending at Boe’s tacos recommendation. No class scene or funeral attendance decision.
planning.storytellingVoice: Intimate character drama with warm adolescent internal voice: Alden wants a solvable food problem while friends name his avoidance; humour belongs to Boe’s defensive attempt to relieve tension.
planning.desire: Find food for Gorgon without facing the funeral question.
planning.obstacle: His friends gently refuse to let the food search hide what matters.
planning.earlyCare: Alden’s earnest care is visible in his concentrated search.
planning.dramaticChange: His reason for staying away is challenged: others may not mind, but his own grief matters. He does not commit to attending.
planning.payoff: Jeremy makes the personal cost clear; Boe restores ordinary companionship with a tactless joke and practical lunch suggestion.
planning.continuingQuestion: Will Alden let himself go to Hannah’s funeral?

choicesAndCallbacks.purpose: notice Boe’s discomfort or the implied avoidance
consider the other mourners or his own place

react privately to absurd doom or Jeremy’s glare

sceneActivities.purpose: Alden studies the meatcase as emotional refuge; funeral question interrupts search; Boe returns attention to tacos.
sceneActivities.rendering: Comic panels; no added purchases or eating.

planning.direction: 18 ImageGen panels in 3 six-panel sheets; wide, detail, over-shoulder, reflective close-up, silent reaction, clearly imagined comic doom, dry glare. Grief stays sincere; slightly exaggerated humour surrounds Boe’s interruption.

signatures.Alden: Intent on food, turns away and tries to sound casual; no forced smile after funeral question.
signatures.Boe: Uncharacteristically hesitant, then absurd joke, apologetic shrug and food recommendation.
signatures.Jeremy: Direct kind firmness; emphatic glare at mistimed humour.

opening.style: Loose ink and watercolor graphic-novel wash on textured paper in indigo, terracotta and cream
opening.moment: Alden turns to the glass counter and tries to sound casual about not going.
opening.speaker: Alden

continuation.end: In the butcher shop Boe questions whether Alden’s food mission avoids Hannah’s funeral. Alden says he probably will not attend because others knew her better. Jeremy urges him to go for his own sake. Boe breaks the painful silence with an absurd prison-break/Chicago-doom joke, gets Jeremy’s glare, and recommends tongue tacos that Alden can eat if Gorgon refuses. No attendance decision or meal outcome.
continuation.nextStart: Wordchain class that day focused on the request for a trade of luck.
continuation.nextEndBefore: His mood was dark for the rest of the day, even though Jeremy kept trying to cheer him up.
continuation.note: Alden practices the luck chain linked to his mother and Hannah’s bubble. Grief, unresolved funeral decision and Hannah’s desire to matter. Stop before the return home and Connie’s note; preserve uncertainty about Hannah’s death.

contains: 他说的是汉娜的葬礼。你会去吗？
他要是不吃，你还可以拿来做午饭。
